test.title: Mini-test · Looking after a home aquarium

paragraphs.text: A home aquarium needs more than water and fish. The most important piece of equipment is the filter, which is usually placed inside the tank at the back. It pumps water through a sponge that traps waste, and then returns clean water to the tank.
Tropical fish also need a heater, a glass tube that keeps the water at around 25 degrees, and a thermometer, usually stuck to the front glass, so that the temperature can be checked daily.
A light is fitted inside the lid. Most fish and plants need about eight to ten hours of light a day, and a timer can switch the light on and off automatically.
The bottom of the tank is covered with a layer of gravel, in which plants can root. Decorations such as rocks give fish places to hide.

Every week, around a quarter of the water should be replaced. Water is removed with a siphon, a flexible tube that also sucks up dirt from the gravel. New water must be treated to remove chlorine and brought to the right temperature before it is added.

document.title: Mini-test · Looking after a home aquarium

items.quote: A light is fitted inside the lid

explanation.en: The light is in the lid: “A light is fitted inside the lid”, the top strip of the tank. Answer: lid.
explanation.kk: Шам қақпақта тұр: «A light is fitted inside the lid». Сызбада бұл аквариумның жоғарғы жолағы. Жауап lid.
explanation.ru: Светильник стоит в крышке: «A light is fitted inside the lid». На схеме это верхняя полоса аквариума. Ответ lid.

items.quote: the filter, which is usually placed inside the tank at the back
keywords: inside the tank at the back

explanation.en: “the filter, which is usually placed inside the tank at the back” → filter. The sponge is part of it.
explanation.kk: «the filter, which is usually placed inside the tank at the back» → filter. Губка — сүзгінің бөлігі.
explanation.ru: «the filter, which is usually placed inside the tank at the back» → filter. Губка — часть фильтра.

items.quote: Tropical fish also need a heater, a glass tube
items.prompt: 3 ____ (a glass tube that keeps water warm)

explanation.en: “a heater, a glass tube that keeps the water at around 25 degrees” → heater. A “thermometer” only shows the temperature.
explanation.kk: «a heater, a glass tube that keeps the water at around 25 degrees» → heater. «Thermometer» температураны тек көрсетеді.
explanation.ru: «a heater, a glass tube that keeps the water at around 25 degrees» → heater. «Thermometer» только показывает температуру.

items.quote: a thermometer, usually stuck to the front glass

explanation.en: “a thermometer, usually stuck to the front glass” → thermometer. Check the spelling.
explanation.kk: «a thermometer, usually stuck to the front glass» → thermometer. Емлесіне назар аударыңыз.
explanation.ru: «a thermometer, usually stuck to the front glass» → thermometer. Проверьте написание.

items.quote: The bottom of the tank is covered with a layer of gravel

explanation.en: “covered with a layer of gravel” → gravel. “Rocks” are decorations, not the bottom layer.
explanation.kk: «covered with a layer of gravel» → gravel. «Rocks» — түбіндегі қабат емес, әшекей.
explanation.ru: «covered with a layer of gravel» → gravel. «Rocks» — украшения, а не слой на дне.

items.quote: around a quarter of the water should be replaced
items.prompt: remove about a 6 ____ of the water

explanation.en: Each week “around a quarter of the water” is replaced. “A” is on the diagram, so the answer is quarter.
explanation.kk: Апта сайын «around a quarter of the water» ауыстырылады. «A» сызбада тұр, сондықтан жауап — quarter.
explanation.ru: Каждую неделю меняют «around a quarter of the water». «A» уже на схеме, ответ quarter.

items.quote: Water is removed with a siphon, a flexible tube

explanation.en: Water is taken out with a siphon: “Water is removed with a siphon, a flexible tube”. Answer: siphon — check the spelling.
explanation.kk: Суды сифонмен ағызады: «Water is removed with a siphon, a flexible tube». Жауап siphon — емлесіне назар аударыңыз.
explanation.ru: Воду сливают сифоном: «Water is removed with a siphon, a flexible tube». Ответ siphon — проверьте написание.

items.quote: that also sucks up dirt from the gravel

explanation.en: “sucks up dirt from the gravel” → dirt. “Gravel” is where from, not what.
explanation.kk: «sucks up dirt from the gravel» → dirt. «Gravel» — неден емес, қайдан.
explanation.ru: «sucks up dirt from the gravel» → dirt. «Gravel» — откуда, а не что.

items.quote: New water must be treated to remove chlorine

explanation.en: New water is treated to “remove chlorine”. The label “no 9 ____” means there must be none. Answer: chlorine.
explanation.kk: Жаңа суды «remove chlorine» үшін өңдейді. «no 9 ____» жазуы хлор болмауы керек дегенді білдіреді. Жауап chlorine.
explanation.ru: Новую воду обрабатывают, чтобы «remove chlorine». Подпись «no 9 ____» значит, что хлора быть не должно. Ответ chlorine.

items.quote: brought to the right temperature before it is added

explanation.en: “brought to the right temperature” → temperature. “25 degrees” in paragraph 2 is a number, but the label needs a word.
explanation.kk: «brought to the right temperature» → temperature. 2-абзацтағы 25 degrees — сан, ал жазуға сөз керек.
explanation.ru: «brought to the right temperature» → temperature. 25 degrees из абзаца 2 — число, а в подписи нужно слово.
